summary: OIO Group filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, providing supplemental disclosure regarding the adjustment of its outstanding warrants in connection with a 1-for-3 reverse share split that became effective April 24, 2026. The exercise ratio was changed so that three warrants are exercisable for one ordinary share (previously one warrant for one share), and the exercise price was adjusted from $11.50 to $34.50 per whole ordinary share. No other corporate action or special situation event is presented; the filing is a routine contractual adjustment following the reverse split. The total number of outstanding warrants was unchanged. Nothing to watch; no risk-arb angle.
